sourceReview.reason: Six-hour retry hold: renewed original-source search on 2026-11-22 did not locate a dated BlackRock statement or independent full-text reporting supporting the attributed 0.01% share and $30-40bn versus $300tn comparison. The CryptoCompass November 19 article republishes BSC News, not a separate corroborating report. BlackRock's August 4 primary release on European tokenized money-market share classes (https://www.blackrock.com/cash/en-ie/press-release-t4) discusses a different event and does not validate this claim.
